note: What a server sends to put the match on hold. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat that asked for the hold, read only for a tournament's hold.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: The hold time left, in seconds, which a client always takes. A hold begins only where it is above zero and the match is not already held.

bits.name: tournament
bits.note: Set for a tournament's hold: as the hold begins, a client shows its tournament display, crediting seat. A hold still needs timeLeft above zero.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat that called the hold.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long the hold may run, in seconds.

bits.name: unlimited
bits.note: Set where the hold is not counted against a limit. Set in everything observed.
